public_rationale: There is evidence for Marcus's narrower observation that prominent researchers advocated a more permissive AGI threshold. But his broader account of substantial change since February 2023 is not settled. OpenAI's economic charter definition dates to 2018, and disagreement between authors does not necessarily show changed goalposts. The available comparisons do not establish the claimed scale of change.
limitations: This does not reject the existence of definitional drift.
The assessment distinguishes changes in criteria from disagreements about whether existing systems satisfy them.
The OpenAI baseline page carries a later structural-update notice; only its dated opening definition is used.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Since early 2023, definitions of AGI have undergone a lot of mission creep.

statement.excerpt: There has been a lot of mission creep ever since.
statement.document_title: The Five Stages of AGI Grief

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that prominent actors substantially changed AGI criteria after February 2023, moving away from general cognitive competence.
The comparison runs from the February 2023 definition identified in the post through publication.
Different definitions existing simultaneously do not by themselves establish that an actor changed its definition.
Mission creep does not require proof of dishonest intent.
criteria.support_condition: Dated comparisons establish multiple substantial changes during the target period toward narrower economic criteria or acceptance of existing capabilities.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The principal alleged changes demonstrably predate the target period or preserve the relevant cognitive requirements, and a sufficiently broad record establishes continuity rather than substantial change.
